info.name: Shopify Retrieves A List Of Custom Collections

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of results to retrieve.
                  (default: 50, maximum: 250)

params.name: ids
params.description: Show only collections specified by a comma-separated list of IDs.

params.name: since_id
params.description: Restrict results to after the specified ID.

params.name: title
params.description: Show custom collections with a given title.

params.name: product_id
params.description: Show custom collections that include a given product.

params.name: handle
params.description: Filter by custom collection handle.

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Show custom collections last updated after date (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00).

params.name: updated_at_max
params.description: Show custom collections last updated before date (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00).

params.name: published_at_min
params.description: Show custom collections published after date (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00).

params.name: published_at_max
params.description: Show custom collections published before date (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00).

params.name: published_status
params.description:
Show custom collectsion with a given published status.
                  (default: any)
                    
                        published: Show only published custom collections.
                        unpublished: Show only unpublished custom collections.
                        any: Show custom collections of any published status.

params.description: Show only certain fields, specified by a comma-separated list of field names.
